name: Fireboy & Watergirl: The Forest Temple

steps: Press Play online. A message shows your room code; send it to your friend. The game starts once they have joined.
Your friend types the code in Join by code, or picks your room in the Rooms list.
The host is Fireboy and the friend is Watergirl. The host clicks the menus and the level map.
tips: Fire kills Watergirl, water kills Fireboy, green goo kills both. Collect the gems and reach both doors.
Everyone needs Ruffle Together 1.0.3.7 or newer; the launcher keeps it current.

description: Fireboy and Watergirl in The Forest Temple (Oslo Albet, Armor Games 2009): the game's own two-player co-op, online. Fireboy and Watergirl work together through 32 temple levels, and each player is on their own PC.

actions.label: Play online
actions.description: Host a room for 2 players, or join one with a code
actions.hint: Send the room code the message shows to your friend. The game opens once they join.

actions.label: Host with your IP (2 players)
actions.hint: Friends copy your address and port (for example 192.168.1.20:7790) and press Join by IP. Radmin, Tailscale and LAN addresses work.

actions.label: Join by IP
actions.hint: The game opens once you are connected to the host.
